work_items.name: Evaluate Harness2 for evidence-based Pixel improvement
work_items.description: User-linked Harness2 evaluated at google-research/harness2 commit 1cfe254e8d25b15f37048c3730134686abe60335, Apache-2.0, Python 3.12/3.13. Deterministic credential-free demo passed parallel and sequential recursion at k=2: two tasks, zero failures, 28 executions and 32 editor calls. Existing executors are OpenCode/Codex; Hermes/DSH needs a substrate adapter. Proposed next experiment: one bounded probe step per explicitly selected test task on PC/VPS, evidence-based persona/skill/delegation suggestions shown as a reviewed PixelSpec diff, versioned adoption and rollback. Keep secrets, connector authorization and enforced access outside the editable harness. Do not replay side-effecting tasks as probes. Acceptance: real Hermes adapter, independent outcome checks, budget/cancellation/reconnect/partial-failure coverage, evidence redaction and unchanged access. Not integrated or shipped as a mobile runtime. Source and plan: https://github.com/google-research/harness2 and https://github.com/wckdboy/niobium/blob/main/PLAN.md.

work_items.name: Linux/macOS desktop preview and shared Android core
work_items.description:
Linux/macOS desktop preview alongside Android; iOS release/signing work is parked by user request. Shared Kotlin core covers Hermes transport, PixelSpec, persona creation, portraits and image palette reduction. Desktop provides independent Hermes/local DSH workspaces, chats, tools, model controls, recovered prompts, rooms and reviewed character creation.
Private native DSH runtime: pinned Node and dependency lock, private Unix socket, authenticated loopback API, explicit lifecycle, delayed detached-task cleanup and messaging adapters that survive moving the app. Actual installer checks reject stale resources and verify hashes/executable modes, the native launcher and local API.
CodeRabbit is connected and reviews PR #11; Greptile automatic reviews/status/approval are disabled. Findings fixed include UI-thread probes, canonical resume parameters, path relocation, shutdown grace, deterministic socket race coverage, corrupt-file guidance and package permissions.
Local validation: 30 shared-core tests, 16 desktop tests, seven Android-specific JVM tests, 67 Node and 15 Python checks. All 16 ARM64 Android 16 emulator checks passed after extraction; two affected transport/DSH regressions were rerun. Signed Android 2.1/code13 installs and cold-launches. Native final CI and release publication remain in progress.
PR #11. Desktop remains a preview: additional local providers, OS vaults, richer history/companion controls, skill/MCP/routine UIs and accessibility/soaks remain follow-up work. Physical Android/16 KB execution and real-account model/image acceptance remain open.

work_items.name: Native desktop setup for additional DSH providers
work_items.description:
After the 2.1 desktop preview, add native OpenAI/Anthropic and compatible provider setup against the pinned DSH contract. Saving a credential must activate the correct provider/model route rather than leaving a dormant key.
Acceptance: controlled local HTTP fixtures verify provider activation, model discovery, a streamed turn and restart persistence without leaking credentials or changing the other engine. Keep DeepSeek working. Real-account acceptance is separate and must be recorded honestly.
Related: NIO-31 for OS credential vaults, NIO-32 for desktop accessibility/performance, NIO-34 for Hermes feature parity.
